title: Get /guides pages indexed (41 of 56 not in Google's index)
body:
URL: /guides
Cluster: guides indexing coverage
Type: technical
Source: GSC URL Inspection 2026-10-27, GSC 2026-09-27..2026-10-24

## Evidence
URL Inspection on all 56 `/guides/*` pages (2026-10-27):
- Submitted and indexed: 15
- Discovered, currently not indexed: 22 (never crawled), e.g. /guides/cravings, /guides/headaches, /guides/insomnia, /guides/fatigue, /guides/what-happens-after-1-month
- Crawled, currently not indexed: 11, e.g. /guides/libido, /guides/tingling-hands-and-feet, /guides/hair-loss, /guides/caffeine-sensitivity, /guides/anger
- URL is unknown to Google: 8 (/guides/bad-breath, /guides/shortness-of-breath, /guides/skin-rash, /guides/what-happens-after-1-day, -5-days, -1-week, -2-weeks, -2-months)

All 56 are in the built sitemap.xml, and /guides/what-happens-after-1-week is linked from 7+ pages, so this is not a missing-sitemap bug. Most indexed guides were last crawled 2026-09-16..09-20; Google has not recrawled since the 2026-10-15 guide template change. The 15 indexed guides carry most of the site's 3,979 impressions, so every guide that gets indexed is likely to add impressions (indexed symptom guides rank 8-10).

## Recommended action
1. In GSC, confirm sitemap.xml is submitted and read recently (Sitemaps report); resubmit it.
2. Request indexing (URL Inspection, manual) for the 8 unknown URLs and the highest-demand discovered ones: cravings, headaches, insomnia, fatigue, cough, what-happens-after-1-week, -1-month.
3. For "Crawled, not indexed" pages, this is a quality signal: compare them with indexed guides (word count, unique sections, sources) and list what each lacks. Feed the weakest into refresh issues (libido and tingling already have their own).
4. Link the timeline guides (1 day to 10 years) to each other in sequence and from /quit-smoking-timeline, and add the top symptom guides to the /guides hub above the fold.
Do not noindex or delete guides yet.

## Next skill
seo-site-inventory (then manual GSC steps)

## Done when
Next audit's URL Inspection shows at least 30 of 56 guides indexed and no guide "unknown to Google".

title: Refresh /guides/tingling-hands-and-feet (dropped out of the index, 183 to 19 impressions)
body:
URL: /guides/tingling-hands-and-feet
Cluster: tingling after quitting smoking
Type: refresh
Source: GSC 2026-09-27..2026-10-24 vs 2026-08-30..2026-09-26

## Evidence
- Impressions 183 to 19 (-90%), clicks 2 to 0, average position 9.8 to 8.1 (it still ranks when shown).
- URL Inspection 2026-10-27: "Crawled, currently not indexed", last crawl 2026-05-22. Google dropped it from the index; the remaining impressions are fading.
- The page was the 3rd-largest guide by impressions in the previous window.
- Content is still the 2026-05-08 version (datePublished = dateModified).

## Recommended action
Refresh the content so Google re-evaluates it: answer "how long does tingling last" in the first 2 sentences with a sourced range, add a symptom table (anxiety/hyperventilation vs circulation vs warning signs), an FAQ from GSC queries, and NHS/CDC/MedlinePlus sources. Keep the emergency warning (one-sided numbness, weakness, trouble speaking). Update dateModified, then request indexing in GSC.
Do not change the URL or slug.

## Next skill
seo-content-brief

## Done when
URL Inspection shows "Submitted and indexed" and 28-day impressions are back above 100.

title: Refresh /guides/libido (dropped out of the index, 149 to 3 impressions)
body:
URL: /guides/libido
Cluster: libido after quitting smoking
Type: refresh
Source: GSC 2026-09-27..2026-10-24 vs 2026-08-30..2026-09-26

## Evidence
- Impressions 149 to 3 (-98%), average position 11.3 to 9.0.
- URL Inspection 2026-10-27: "Crawled, currently not indexed", last crawl 2026-05-20.
- Amplitude 2026-09-29..10-26: 2 views (some readers still reach it via internal links).

## Recommended action
Refresh with a clear answer first (does sex drive improve, when, why a short dip can happen), a timeline table with sourced points (circulation, erectile function: NHS, CDC, peer-reviewed), an FAQ from GSC queries, and a Sources section. Keep it non-explicit and medical in tone. Update dateModified, then request indexing.

## Next skill
seo-content-brief

## Done when
URL Inspection shows "Submitted and indexed" and 28-day impressions are back above 75.

title: Push /guides/what-happens-after-3-days to page 1 (queries at positions 4-17)
body:
URL: /guides/what-happens-after-3-days
Cluster: 3 days without smoking
Type: page-2-push
Source: GSC 2026-09-27..2026-10-24 vs 2026-08-30..2026-09-26

## Evidence
- Page: 112 impressions (prev 54), 0 clicks, average position 32.9 (prev 35.6). Indexed, last crawl 2026-09-19.
- "3 days without smoking" 5 impr, position 10 (prev 18). "3 days no smoking" 5 impr, 16.8 (prev 9.6). "no cigarettes for 3 days" 3 impr, 3.7 (new). "day 3 without nicotine" 3 impr, 9.3.
- "day 3 no smoking" 10 impr, 41.2 (prev 65); "day 3 of not smoking" 85 and "quit smoking day 3" 82: the "day 3" phrasing ranks far worse than "3 days".

## Recommended action
Add "day 3" language to the H1/intro and an H2 ("Day 3 without smoking: why it often feels hardest"), a short hour-by-hour table for hours 48-72 with sourced points, and an FAQ using the GSC queries. Link to it from /guides/what-happens-after-2-days, /guides/what-happens-after-5-days, /first-week-quit-smoking and /nicotine-withdrawal-timeline with "day 3" anchor text.

## Next skill
seo-content-brief

## Done when
"3 days without smoking" and "day 3 no smoking" both average position 10 or better over 28 days.
